use_cases: Toggle between list and grid views in product catalogs
Switch content display density in dashboards
Change card layouts for browsing vs. scanning modes
Adapt item display for different screen sizes
Control layout mode for responsive content grids
ai_summary: An animated layout container component that enables users to toggle between list view, 2-column grid, and 4-column grid layouts with smooth motion/react animations. Features staggered child element animations and hover effects on cards. Ideal for e-commerce product grids, SaaS dashboards, and media content browsers where users need flexible visual density controls. Responsive design adapts from mobile to desktop with optimized column configurations.
